snippet.title: FINAL FANTASY VII REVELATION | The Planet's Crisis Trailer
snippet.description:
The mighty Weapons have awakened across the planet.
Take to the skies aboard the Highwind, explore a vast world, and chart your own course through an adventure on an unprecedented scale.

A vast planet awaits. Everything leads here.

Release Date: Spring 2027

Platforms: PlayStation®5 / Nintendo Switch™ 2 / Xbox Series X|S / Windows / Steam / Epic Games Store
